for _, v in ipairs(t2.value20) do

    match = match(v, "^(.+) %(") or v
    t1.value1 = value1

    local v88 = false

    for _, selectedSkill in ipairs(t2.value21.selectedSkills) do
        if selectedSkill == match then
            v88 = true

            break
        end
    end

    npc(t2.value45, v, v88, function(p55)
        if p55 then
            local selectedSkills = t2.value21.selectedSkills
            local v92 = match

            table.insert(selectedSkills, v92)

            return
        else
            for i = #t2.value21.selectedSkills, 1, -1 do
                if t2.value21.selectedSkills[i] == match then
                    table.remove(t2.value21.selectedSkills, i)

                    return
                end
            end

            return
        end
    end)
end

            return

		})
    end)

end

            end
        end
    end)

        t2.value12("TextLabel", {
			["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),

function t2.value59(p74, p75, p76)
    if typeof(p74) == "Vector3" then
        v231 = p74
    else
        v231 = false
    end

    local v231_ = v231 or p74.Position

    if p76 == 1 then
        return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(0, 0, -p75), v231_)
    else
        if p76 == 2 then
            return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(0, 0, p75), v231_)
        else
            if p76 == 3 then
                return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(-p75, 0, 0), v231_)
            else
                if p76 == 4 then
                    return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(p75, 0, 0), v231_)
                else
                    if p76 == 5 then
                        return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(0, p75, 0), v231_) * CFrame.Angles(-1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
                    else
                        return CFrame.new(v231_ + Vector3.new(0, 0, -p75), v231_)
                    end

                    return
                end

                return
            end

            return
        end

        return
    end
end
function getNearestNPC(p77)
    local Character = t2.value6.Character
    if Character then
        Character = t2.value6.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    if not Character then
        return nil
    end
    local v150 = p77 or t2.value18[t2.value21.selectedNPC]
    local v151
    local v152 = (1 / 0)
    local value5 = t2.value5
    value5 = value5:FindFirstChild("Mapa")
    if value5 then
        value5 = t2.value5.Mapa:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
    end
    value5 = value5 or (t2.value5:FindFirstChild("Enemies") or (t2.value5:FindFirstChild("NPCs") or t2.value5:FindFirstChild("NPC\'s")))
    local ipairs_, v155
    if value5 then
        ipairs_ = ipairs

        for _, child in ipairs_(value5:GetChildren()) do
            ipairs_ = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if ipairs_ then
                v155 = ipairs_.Health > 0

                if v155 then
                    if v150 then
                        v155 = child.Name:lower():find(v150:lower())
                    else
                        v155 = v150
                    end
                end
            else
                v155 = ipairs_
            end

            if v155 then
                v155 = child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or child.PrimaryPart

                if v155 then
                    ipairs_ = (v155.Position - Character.Position).Magnitude

                    if ipairs_ < v152 then
                        v151 = child
                        v152 = ipairs_
                        ipairs_ = v151
                        v151 = ipairs_
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        ipairs_ = v151
    end
    if v151 then
        return v151
    end
    value5 = ipairs
    local value52 = t2.value5
    for _, descendant in value5(value52:GetDescendants()) do
        v155 = descendant:IsA("Model")

        if v155 then
            v155 = descendant ~= t2.value6.Character
        end

        if v155 then
            v155 = descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if v155 then
                v155 = v155.Health > 0

                if v155 then
                    if v150 then
                        v155 = descendant.Name

                        local lower = v155.lower
                        local lower2 = v150.lower

                        v155 = lower(v155):find(lower2(v150))
                    else
                        v155 = v150
                    end
                end
            end

            if v155 then
                v155 = descendant:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or descendant.PrimaryPart

                if v155 then
                    v155 = (v155.Position - Character.Position).Magnitude

                    if v155 < v152 then
                        v151 = descendant
                        v152 = v155
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return v151
end
